name: What does a gurgling sound in my drains mean?

mainEntity.name: What does a gurgling sound in my drains mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gurgling sounds in drains typically indicate a partial blockage or a venting issue within your plumbing system. When water flows down a drain, air needs to enter the pipe behind it. If a vent pipe is blocked, or a clog creates a vacuum, air can be drawn through the trap, causing a gurgling sound. This often happens after flushing a toilet or draining a sink. Ignoring gurgling can lead to slower drainage and eventually a complete clog.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gurgling in drains usually points to a partial blockage or a problem with your plumbing vent system, affecting proper airflow.
